events.continuity_hook: Continues the Denver conference episode after hotel rates and reimbursement guidance narrowed the choices.
events.interaction_goal: Select the Denver flight-and-hotel pairing to book, call out cancellation and receipt items, and identify anything to confirm with the hotel before checkout.
events.scenario_brief: Finance confirmed that the official Denver conference block will not be reimbursed above the nightly cap while lower-cost rooms are available nearby. Tessa is weighing a Tuesday morning Salt Lake City to Denver nonstop plus two hotel nights against a Monday afternoon arrival that adds a third night but gives more buffer before the Tuesday noon opening. The rail-adjacent hotel still includes breakfast, the walking-distance hotel has easier convention access but weaker dinner options, and the unresolved choice is whether arrival reliability justifies the extra night.

events.continuity_hook: Closes the Denver conference details after the hotel and flight choice was made.
events.interaction_goal: Build a concise pre-trip timing plan and flag any phone-call items for hotel breakfast hours, baggage storage, or rail timing.
events.scenario_brief: Tessa booked the Tuesday morning nonstop and the rail-adjacent hotel for Tuesday and Wednesday nights. A Wednesday 7:30 a.m. breakfast roundtable was added, and light snow is in the forecast, so she wants the airport train, bag drop, convention commute, return flight buffer, seat selection, and evening food options checked. The remaining issue is how early she should leave the Thursday closing session for the airport.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a personal family weekend after the December work conference arrangements are nearly finished.
events.interaction_goal: Compare flight timing and hotel zones, including drive time to fields, room setup, breakfast, parking, and airport return.
events.scenario_brief: Tessa's younger teenager's team finalized a winter soccer tournament in the Phoenix East Valley, with a Friday evening team check-in, Saturday games split between Mesa and Gilbert, and a possible Sunday late-afternoon final. She and her spouse need Salt Lake City flights and a Friday-to-Monday hotel that keeps school-day departure reasonable, has workable breakfast, and does not leave them stuck hunting dinner after games. The unresolved choice is Sunday night flight home versus Monday morning return.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Mesa tournament weekend after field locations changed the driving logic.
events.interaction_goal: Rank the hotel areas and booking timing, then list the details Tessa should verify before paying for a nonrefundable room.
events.scenario_brief: The tournament posted site assignments, and most Saturday matches are farther southeast than expected. The tournament hotel block has a two-queen room and early breakfast but a soon cancellation cutoff, while an airport-area property is cheaper and easier for Monday's flight yet creates longer drives after evening games. The unresolved issue is whether to stay by the fields for comfort or split the difference in Chandler.

events.continuity_hook: Moves from personal travel back into the spring recruitment calendar.
events.interaction_goal: Map realistic route shapes, estimate drive pressure between events, and identify practical hotel zones with breakfast and nearby dinner.
events.scenario_brief: Tessa starts a February spring-yield and transfer swing in Northern California: Monday evening admitted-student reception in Sacramento, Tuesday morning community-college fair in Stockton, Wednesday counselor lunch in Walnut Creek, and Thursday morning coffee with families near Santa Rosa. She needs to compare flying into Sacramento and home from Oakland against a simpler Sacramento round trip with more driving. Hotel areas, car pickup timing, and the Thursday afternoon departure airport remain open.

events.continuity_hook: Updates the Northern California swing after two event times and locations changed.
events.interaction_goal: Recommend the least stressful hotel sequence and identify which return airport should stay in the flight search before booking.
events.scenario_brief: The Wednesday lunch moved from Walnut Creek to Pleasant Hill, and the Santa Rosa coffee shifted later in the morning, so Tessa no longer has to be as far north on Wednesday night. She is considering two East Bay nights versus one East Bay night and one Santa Rosa-area night, with reimbursement caps and late-arrival food still in play. The remaining flight question is whether an Oakland return after the Thursday coffee leaves enough buffer or if Sacramento is safer despite the backtrack.
